final: WITH grouped AS (SELECT ordersmark, COUNT(*) AS execution_count FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), shares AS (SELECT ordersmark, execution_count, CAST(execution_count AS REAL) / SUM(execution_count) OVER () AS share, 1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER () AS average_share FROM grouped) SELECT ordersmark, execution_count, share, share - average_share AS share_minus_average FROM shares ORDER BY share_minus_average DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
